key_insight: Predicting time increments with a Fourier Neural Operator improves Rayleigh-Bénard convection surrogate accuracy over standard full-state prediction.
engineering_relevance: The model offers a compact, fast CFD surrogate that can accelerate reduced-order simulation workflows while preserving benchmark-level accuracy.
method: FNO predicts time increments instead of full solutions
Compact model: 314k parameters, 1.26 MB, ~7 ms inference
evidence_signal: The abstract reports higher accuracy than a standard FNO baseline and similar accuracy to prior benchmarks, with generalization to finer meshes.
watch_item: Accuracy is still constrained by the resolution of the training data, so finer-mesh deployment may not improve fidelity beyond what the training set supports.
paper_title: Fourier Neural Operators for Rayleigh-Bénard Convection
